memory.content: Skool has no connector. Access the community as admin via the box browser; sign in once so the session persists.
Never add people to a newsletter without opting in. Paid community invites come after relationship and value, not as a first cold pitch.
Member emails are often not on the Members list. Admin Membership (gear) on each member shows the full profile including email; CSV export may require an email verification code.
After mass member email, check the admin inbox for Delivery Status failures. Ban or remove members whose addresses bounce (not found, blocked, or permanently undeliverable).

Email for community outreach may use Fastmail or Gmail if connected. Prefer the admin's usual From address. Fastmail allows high daily volume but prohibits duplicative bulk sending in its terms — warn before large identical blasts.
Track which members post what so later emails and replies can be personalized. Collate unanswered or recurring questions from posts into a list for live Q&A sessions.

skills.description: Use when managing a Skool community via the browser: feed, classroom, calendar, about, settings read-only recon, or admin check-ins.

  calendar, about, settings read-only recon, or admin check-ins.
---
# Skool community ops

Use when the admin wants a snapshot of their Skool community, help with posts/events/classroom, or day-to-day community management. Skool has no API connector — drive the signed-in box browser.

## Setup
1. Confirm signed in as the community admin. If not, hand the screen for login once.
2. Open the community URL they name (or ask once).

## Snapshot
Visit Community, Classroom, Calendar, Members, About (and Settings read-only if useful). Report: member counts, upcoming events, pinned/recent posts, courses, pricing/tiers if shown. Do not change settings or post unless asked.

## Engagement
When asked for posts worth commenting on (Discover / Skoolers / peer communities): pick topic-relevant posts with clear angles. Return links + one-line why. Draft comments only when asked; never post without explicit yes.

## Guardrails
No spam, no scraping emails for cold lists, no silent setting changes. Prefer useful, human engagement.

---
# Skool member management

Use for Active/Banned lists, name+email collection, membership changes, and bans.

## List names
Members tab → Active (or other filters). Paginate fully. Deliver names in chat; optionally save a backup file.

## Emails
Emails often hide off the list. Prefer Membership (gear) on each row for name + email + handle. CSV Export may need a verification code emailed to the admin — use an in-chat form for the code, never ask them to paste codes in chat. After export, deliver a CSV.

## Outreach email
Draft first; wait for explicit send. Personalize with first name. Skip obviously fake or duplicated emails until confirmed. After sending, show one full sample (from, to, time, subject, body) and the success count. Check inbox for bounce DSNs and report them.

## Ban / remove
Only after explicit ask. Membership → Ban from group → confirm. Leave optional post-deletion off unless asked. Verify under Banned. Report each name.

# Skool member post tracker

Use when the admin wants a running picture of who posts, on what topics, so later DMs/emails/comments can be personal.

## Capture
1. Browse Community feed (and filters/categories if any).
2. For each recent post worth remembering: author name/handle, date, category, title/snippet, engagement, post URL.
3. Append to a durable note or CSV on disk (columns: date, author, handle, category, title, url, notes). Deduplicate by URL.

## Use later
Before drafting personalized outreach or replies, search that log for the person. Reference their actual post — never invent activity.

## Cadence
On demand, or as a routine if they ask for a regular digest. Stay quiet when nothing new.

# Skool Q&A collation

Use when preparing a live or async Q&A from questions members already asked in posts/comments.

## Gather
1. Scan Community feed (and Classroom Q&A threads if relevant) for recent questions — post titles that ask, comment threads with open questions, unanswered asks.
2. Record: question text (short paraphrase ok), asker, post URL, date, topic tags.

## Collate
Group by theme. Flag duplicates. Mark already-answered vs still open. Produce a short run-of-show list the host can use live.

## Deliver
Send a clean list in chat (and optional markdown/CSV file). Do not invent questions. Do not reply in-thread unless asked.
